description: This file defines the PersonRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository for managing PersonEntity objects. It includes methods for finding a person by email and checking if an email exists.

classes.name: PersonRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for PersonEntity, providing CRUD operations and custom query methods by email.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a PersonEntity by email, returning an Optional.

methods.name: existsByEmail
methods.description: Checks if a PersonEntity with the given email exists.
